title: CONTAINSSTRINGEXACT matches case and takes wildcards literally
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Case 1", CONTAINSSTRINGEXACT ( "abcd", "bc" ), "Case 2", CONTAINSSTRINGEXACT ( "abcd", "BC" ), "Case 3", CONTAINSSTRINGEXACT ( "abcd", "a*d" ), "Case 4", CONTAINSSTRINGEXACT ( "abcd", "ef" ) )

source.supports: the documented query returns TRUE FALSE FALSE FALSE
